svg.aria-label: A, B and D analyze the same simulated image, with one lane per standard. C models clipping of a continuous two-dimensional Gaussian with a detector ceiling of 4095 total counts and a 100-count background, followed by exposure correction. D varies the ROI half-height while retaining the background and calibration definitions.
